# WoW AndroWhere 0.8.4

- **Faster emulation for private servers.** **Client** → Graphics has a new **Faster emulation** switch. It turns off some of Box64's safety checks so the 3.3.5a client runs faster. It's off by default; if an area or addon crashes or looks wrong with it on, turn it off.
- **Newer Box64 for private servers.** The 3.3.5a client now runs on Box64 0.4.4 (was 0.4.2), which starts and runs games a bit faster.

## Install

Download **WoW-AndroWhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.8.3 and keeps your settings, saved login, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
